canonical_name: No Network Communication and Data Flows Documented
description: Representations of authorized network communication and data flows are not maintained.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management IT asset management and inventory teams Configuration management programs Organizations maintaining technology inventories

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of network diagrams, missing data flow documentation, lack of network segmentation maps, or gaps in traffic pattern documentation. Organizations should maintain current representations including network topology diagrams, data flow diagrams, firewall rulesets, API communications, and third-party data exchanges.
